card.name: Freeing someone from a burden or chore
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about relieving people of work or freeing up their time, such as 'free up', 'relieve ... of', 'ease your workload' and 'outsourcing'. It fires on the word that completes or follows the relieving verb.

modes.label: Free up / relieve of
modes.description: Verb phrases about taking a burden off someone so they can do other things.
modes.example: to provide general care and free<< up>> registered nurses, therapists, and doctors.

modes.label: Burden or time being saved
modes.description: Nouns for the chore or time cost that is being lifted, after words like relieve, ease or time-consuming.
modes.example: we have expert writers on our panel to ease your<< workload>>.

modes.label: Outsourcing and hosting
modes.description: Words about handing tasks to someone else so people can spend time on what matters.
modes.example: wouldn?t you rather<< spend>> your time building an awesome world

card.writes: It pushes toward words about taking over duties, such as hosting, managing tasks and lightening load.
card.plain: It lights up when text says someone is relieved of a chore so their time is freed.
